mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or during non-declining periods FEDFUNDS rises but returns remain positive.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of UNRATE above 3.5% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%, or returns are positive when UNRATE stays below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with robust demand, paradoxically boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase in the same month, or returns are positive when only one proxy rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising supply growth (INDPRO) alongside weakening labor market pressures (UNRATE below 3.5%) creates a favorable environment for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansion periods defined by INDPRO > 109.5 and UNRATE < 3.5%, or during other regimes the returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate alongside stable or declining CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a preemptive tightening that does not immediately harm equity valuations, leading to short-term positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases while CPIAUCSL does not rise in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL remains stable or falls, or when FEDFUNDS rises with CPIAUCSL rising returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in job market activity (HOUST exceeding 1300) indicates strong labor demand, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when HOUST crosses above 1300, or returns are positive when HOUST remains below 1300.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates coupled with persistent GDP growth (GDPC1) suggests resilient economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases and GDPC1 also increases in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 increase in the same month within a tightening cycle, or returns are positive outside such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market participation (PAYEMS exceeding 151,308) signals robust employment growth, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS exceeds 151,308, or returns are positive when PAYEMS remains below that threshold.
